body_html:
The Fame high-back task chair pairs a breathable mesh back with weight-sensing intelligence, so it reads each user and delivers the right recline tension automatically — no levers to fuss with. A height-adjustable lumbar support and contoured seat keep posture honest through long shifts, while the clean, modern profile suits everything from a hospital admin floor to a private practice. It is an ergonomic office chair that earns its place without asking staff to learn it.

Features

  • Weight-sensing synchro-tilter mechanism with multi-position tilt lock
  • Automatic tilt-tension adjustment — the chair responds to the user's weight
  • Seat depth adjustment and pneumatic seat-height adjustment
  • Flexible, height-adjustable lumbar support for proper posture
  • Height-adjustable T-arms with sliding and rotating armcaps
  • Breathable black mesh seat and back for all-day air-flow
  • Black base with dual-wheel carpet casters
  • Optional upholstered adjustable headrest (OTG11403)
  • 300 lb weight capacity

Specifications

Overall dimensions 27"W x 22.5"D x 41"H with a 15.5"–19.5" seat-height range and a chair weight of 35.5 lbs (16.1 kg). Made in Canada by Global Furniture Group under the Offices To Go line and backed by a 2-year warranty.

Office Central / Brant Business Interiors is a family-owned Canadian dealer (since 1964, 296 George St N, Peterborough ON) and an OECM-eligible supplier — Ontario institutional buyers can order without an open tender. Request a Quote for volume pricing, or call 1-800-835-9565.
